name: oneaquahealth
description: Runs the OneAquaHealth Insight API (api/) and dashboard (dashboard/) together

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix dashboard install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix dashboard run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm --prefix api start" "npm --prefix dashboard start"
